title: Finite coefficient unit and over-line realization coordinates
statement: Let l be prime, E a finite extension of Q_l, n≥0 with finite R=O_E/l^(n+1), and A=ULift R. For any scheme T with an exponent-unit witness hT and section-normalized coordinates c:CoefficientCoordinates l E n T hT [def-sp-p1-coefficient-coordinates], define finiteUnitCoordinate as the inverse composite of the exact single-functor comparison, c.unit, and coefficient evaluation. It identifies evaluation of the coefficient-system unit [def-sp-tower-class-coefficients] with intrinsic realization of the ordinary derived coefficient unit [sk-lem-geo-p1-cohomology]. For schemes X,S and e:X≅P¹_S, define finiteOverRealization as ordinary derived inverse image along e followed by intrinsic realization on X. Given coordinates cX on X, finiteOverUnitCoordinate composes finiteUnitCoordinate with the inverse ordinary-unit pullback along e. These are the same existing definitions, with the same names, signatures and bodies, relocated from the parent module.

proof.text: Use exact single-functor comparisons and the given normalized unit coordinate, then the ordinary unit pullback along e. These are explicit composites of existing isomorphisms; no data are chosen from an existence theorem.

def finiteOverUnitCoordinate (n : ℕ) [Finite (SpTowerShriek.R l E n)]
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (e : X ≅ ProjectiveLine S)
    {hX : IsUnit ((l ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : Γ(X, ⊤))}
    (c : SpTowerP1.CoefficientCoordinates l E n X hX) :
    (SpTowerShriek.Ev l E X n).obj (unit X (Arings l E X)) ≅
      (finiteOverRealization l E n e).obj (geoP1Unit (FiniteRing l E n) (ProjectiveLine S))
